build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator to generate physics puzzle scenarios
create_dynamic_bars: create dynamic bar objects with increasing scale and angle using C.add in the scene
add_dynamic_balls: add dynamic ball objects to the scene with specific position and scale parameters
update_task_goal: update the task goal by setting body relationships like TOUCHING via C.update_task
set_solution_metadata: set the solution tier metadata using C.set_meta to classify task difficulty
